Case :- Transfer Application (Criminal) No. - 100 of 2024
Applicant :- Pallavi Srivastava

Opposite Party :- State Of Up Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashok Kumar Upadhyay,Om Prakash Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Anjana Verma,Ayush Kumar Shukla,G.A.,Surya Bhan Yadav,Udai
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the opposite party nos. 2-4, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. This transfer application under section 407 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant (wife) with a prayer to allow the instant application and transfer the Complaint Case No. 3215 of 2021 (Pallavi Srivastava Versus Alok Srivastava) under sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act,
pending in the Court of Civil Judge (Junior Division)/ (Fast Tract Court) (Crime against Women),
Bhadohi, Gyanpur to a competent Court at Allahabad.

sentences.text: 3. Brief facts of the case are that the marriage of the applicant and opposite party no.2 was solemnized on 23.02.2018 and she went to her matrimonial house district- Muzaffarpur, Bihar but the family members (in-laws) as well as the opposite party no.2 were not happy with the dowry given in the marriage and were torturing and harassing the applicant in lieu of demand of additional dowry.
Thereafter some dispute arose between them, which resulted into initiation of the case in hand.

sentences.text:
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant along with her parents were residing at her maternal uncle residence at Purani Bazar Qasba Gyanpur post and police station Gyanpur, district-Bhadohi at the time of filing of the case and now the relations between the applicant and her parents with her maternal uncle have become strained and as such the applicant along with her parents has shifted at her parental residence at L.C.-74/A.D.A. Colony, Naini,
Allahabad.
It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is a lady and she has been deserted by her husband and in-laws.
She has no source of income to maintain herself and fully dependent upon her parents.
It is very difficult for her to go the Bhadohi at Gyanpur for the pairvee of the case.
On these grounds a prayer has been made to transfer the said case from Bhadohi at Gyanpur to district-Allahabad.
5. Per contra, learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the opposite party nos.2-4 opposed the prayer made in the transfer application but however, could not dispute the factual aspect of the matter.

6. In the matrimonial matters, the convenience of wife and in particular that she has no one in her family to escort her to undertake a long journey has been held to be good ground for transfer of case as is also evident from Hon'ble Apex Court's decision in Anjali Ashok Sadhwani vs. Ashok Kishinchand Sadhwani, AIR 2009 SC 1374 and Fatema vs. Jafri Syed Husain @ Syed Parvez Jafferi,
AIR 2009 SC 1773.
7.

entities.text: Anjali Ashok Sadhwani vs. Ashok Kishinchand Sadhwani, AIR 2009 SC 1374
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text:
Fatema vs. Jafri Syed Husain @ Syed Parvez Jafferi,
AIR 2009 SC 1773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Convenience of wife to pursue the proceedings is a relevant factor if pleaded bona fide for justifying transfer of a matter to the place where it is convenient to the wife.
In the present case it not in dispute that applicant-wife is residing at Allahabad.
Looking to the facts of the case, as stated above, I am of the view that it is in the interest of justice that the instant transfer application should be allowed.
8. In view of the above, the present transfer application is allowed.

Let the Complaint Case No. 3215 of 2021 (Pallavi Srivastava Versus Alok Srivastava) under sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 I.P.C.
and 3/4 D.P. Act be transferred from the Court of Civil Judge (Junior Division)/ (Fast Tract Court)
(Crime against Women), Bhadohi, Gyanpur to a competent Court at District Allahabad.
